verdict.rationale: The GST system runs an official Developer Portal (developer.gst.gov.in/apiportal) with registration and login, which points to a first-party public API program. However, the evidence shows only the portal's home, register, login and feedback pages, with no endpoint documentation or proof that GST workflows can actually be driven programmatically. The rest of the pack covers manual web-portal help modules, not an API. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints and reference, coverage of core workflows such as returns, registration and payments via the API, auth and access model details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
